text:
adele: Bringing up Manta (open 2.7B) embed on staging. Quick sanity: recall@10 drop vs Falcon-emb baseline. Anyone seeing this?

mike: Saw a similar blip on wiki_holdout earlier today, ~6% drop @10. Suspect quantization pipeline.

jun: kmeans silhouette dropped too (.62 -> .53). Also higher L2 variance in batch samples.

eva: Can you paste the eval summary?

adele: Sure, quick paste:
```
model: manta-2.7b
precision: int8-perchannel
dataset: wiki_holdout_10k
recall@1: 0.782 -> 0.775 (-0.9%)
recall@10: 0.912 -> 0.856 (-6.1%)
silhouette: 0.62 -> 0.53
avg_cos_shift: -0.018
```

mike: avg_cos_shift negative like that points to a norm/bias shift post-quant. Maybe layernorm folding or rounding causing mean shift.

jun: :eyes: check embedding norm distribution with the distrib tool: `python -m embed_eval.distrib --model manta --mode norms`

adele: Ran it: pre-quant mean norm 1.03, int8 mean 0.97. stdev increased 0.12 -> 0.18. So norms compressed and noisier.

eva: Downstream cosine sim expects near unit-norm. That explains hit in recall and silhouette. Options: post-quant rescale or bias-correction, or try different quant scheme.

mike: Try per-tensor int8 (we had earlier marginally smaller hit on a different model) vs per-channel. Per-channel should be better on capacity but maybe our scale tables are off.

jun: I spun a quick micro-batch with per-tensor int8 + out_scale correction: recall@10 -> 0.90, silhouette 0.59. Not full recovery but closer to fp16.

adele: Noted that HNSW index sensitivity increased — to hit comparable recall I bumped ef_search 64 -> 128. Latency tradeoff obvious.

eva: Ops note: in perf harness that ef_search bump increases tail latency ~12%. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

mike: For canary that cost is ok, but long-term we want quant fix. Action items: 1) run per-tensor + bias-corr sweep, 2) try static post-norm scaling (multiply by trainable scalar or calibrate on holdout), 3) rerun recall@k across multilingual holdouts and short-query cohorts.

adele: I'll queue those experiments and push artifacts to the `manta-int8-handshake` runset. Will also attach sample uMAPs and KNN diffs.

ops-bot: experiment queued: manta-int8-handshake-2026-03-23-001. Estimated run time ~2h.

jun: Also add cluster purity eval on user-query cohort (k=5). I saw some anchor splits that look like per-channel quant noise.

adele: Added that to the job. Will post interim numbers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
